title: On-Call Dispatch Schedule Configuration
description: Declarative configuration for resolving PagerDuty on-call schedules and publishing them to a provider destination.

space.description: Slack workspace hostname. This maps to an environment variable named SLACK_API_KEY_<WORKSPACE>, with non-alphanumeric characters replaced by underscores.

channel_id.description: Slack channel ID to update or post to.

set_channel_topic.description: When true, update the Slack channel topic. When false, post a channel message.

webhook_env.description: Environment variable containing the Microsoft Teams Workflows webhook URL.

PagerDutyScheduleGroup.description: A rendered schedule section with an optional complete destination override.

destination.description: Complete destination override for this group. When omitted, the top-level destination is used.

slack_group_id.description: Optional Slack user group ID to update. Valid only when the effective destination provider is Slack.

swap_on_odd_weeks.description: When true, swap the two entries during odd ISO week numbers. Only valid with exactly two entries.

PagerDutyScheduleGroup.title: PagerDutyScheduleGroup

PagerDutyScheduleEntries.description: One or more PagerDuty schedules to resolve for this output section.

schedule_id.description: PagerDuty schedule ID to query for the current on-call user.

label.description: Human-readable label used in the destination message or Slack channel topic.

id.description: Stable identifier for this schedule configuration.

schedule.description: Cadence this file should run for. The CLI --frequency value must match this field unless the file is intentionally skipped.

suspended.description: When true, skip this schedule configuration without making changes.

destination.description: Default provider destination for groups that do not define an override.

pagerduty_tenant.description: PagerDuty tenant hostname. This maps to an environment variable named PAGERDUTY_API_KEY_<TENANT>, with non-alphanumeric characters replaced by underscores.

schedule_groups.description: Output sections keyed by group name. Each group contains one or more PagerDuty schedules and may replace the default destination.

message_header.description: Optional text prepended to every rendered destination update.

message_footer.description: Optional text appended to every rendered destination update.
